You are assembling a clinical visit note. The sentences of one note are listed below in random order. Each sentence carries, in square brackets, the heading it was written under. File every sentence under that heading. In the JSON, the headings are the keys subjective, objective_exam, objective_results and assessment_and_plan. Return each sentence ID under exactly one heading. Do not leave any sentence out and do not invent IDs.

S2 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: A prescription for clindamycin 400 mg 2 times per day for 7 days will be provided as he does seem to have an infection.

S5 [SUBJECTIVE]: He reports the ulcer has recently become red and is draining.

S8 [OBJECTIVE RESULTS]: 3 views of the right foot were taken.
S9 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: Right diabetic foot ulcer.
S10 [SUBJECTIVE]: He is taking medication for this, however, he does not monitor his blood sugar consistently.

S12 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: He will also be placed in a surgical shoe to provide increased support for the next month.

S14 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: There is some redness and drainage present as well as edema.
S15 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: Nontender to palpation.

S17 [OBJECTIVE RESULTS]: These reveal no evidence of osteomyelitis.

S19 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: After reviewing the patient's examination and radiographic findings today, I have had a lengthy discussion with the patient in regards to his current symptoms.
S20 [SUBJECTIVE]: Gregory Hernandez is a pleasant 40-year-old male who presents to the clinic today for the evaluation of a non-healing right foot ulcer.
S21 [OBJECTIVE EXAM]: MSK: Examination of the right foot: There is a 1 x 2 inch circular wound on the dorsal aspect laterally just proximal to the 5th MTP joint.
S22 [SUBJECTIVE]: Onset of ulcer was approximately 2 months ago after walking barefoot on the beach.
S23 [SUBJECTIVE]: At times he will also experience throbbing pain.
S24 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: I have recommended that we obtain an ankle brachial index to determine the blood supply in his foot.
S25 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: Debridement will be performed.
